notes.title: The Hive - Update 1.301 Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6925470/04db4e144263af369d670a61032ca805439b5d3d.png[/img]

[h1]The Hive 1.301 Patch Notes[/h1]

This patch addresses many long-standing issues and implements significant improvements based on feedback from our players and reviews over an extended period. Your input has been invaluable in helping us refine and improve the game. Thank you for your continued support!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[b]Resolved a major performance issue[/b] related to collisions:
[list]
    [*]Identified and fixed inefficiencies in how collisions were handled across all levels.
    [*][b]Result:[/b] Noticeable performance improvements across the game, particularly on larger maps with more units and effects.
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] This fix addresses long-standing performance bottlenecks, significantly improving the player experience by enhancing stability and responsiveness.

[h2]Water Shader Updates[/h2]
[b]Water Shader:[/b] Completely overhauled and tailored to meet project needs:
[list]
    [*]Fixed compatibility issues with Unity 2019 that rendered the old shader broken.
    [*]The new shader supports adjustable speed and flow direction, offering greater flexibility and visual consistency.
[/list]
[b]Main Menu Water Shader:[/b] Updated to match the new system so it now functions properly and aligns with in-game water visuals.

[b]Why:[/b] These changes were necessary to restore broken water shaders while improving customization and maintaining consistency in visual quality.

[h2]Unit Changes[/h2]

[h3]Legionnaire[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Squad size: [b]1 unit[/b]
    [*][b]Updated Values:[/b]
        [list]
            [*]Construction time: [b]3[/b]
            [*]Food cost: [b]10[/b]
            [*]Population usage: [b]1[/b]
            [*]Speed: [b]0.25[/b] (up from 0.2)
            [*]HP: [b]45[/b] (up from 35)
        [/list]
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] Squad mechanics were removed to make units easier to control. In response, Legionnaires were adjusted to focus on being fast, swarming DPS units and gap closers, with values balanced for their new role as single units.

[h3]Hunter[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Group size: [b]1 unit[/b]
    [*]Construction time: [b]10[/b]
    [*]Food cost: [b]30[/b]
    [*]Population usage: [b]2[/b]
    [*]Speed: [b]0.18[/b]
    [*]Life: [b]80[/b]
    [*]Max life: [b]80[/b]
    [*]Damage: [b]6[/b]
    [*]Armor Pierce: [b]3[/b]
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] Hunters have also been converted to single units for improved control. Their stats were updated to reflect their new role as resilient light skirmishers, with a focus on consistent damage and flexibility in early-game strategies.

[h3]Worker[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Speed increased from [b]0.16[/b] to [b]0.2[/b].
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] Workers were made faster to improve resource collection efficiency and overall game pacing, particularly in early-game scenarios.

[h3]Rhino[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Size increased to [b]2.5[/b].
    [*]Speed increased from [b]0.16[/b] to [b]0.2[/b].
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] Increasing the Rhino’s size and speed reinforces its role as a heavy frontline tank, enabling it to reach key targets faster and hold its position more effectively in combat.

[h3]Wasp[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Angle speed increased from [b]7[/b] to [b]20[/b], improving handling.
    [*]Speed increased from [b]0.2[/b] to [b]0.5[/b], making it extremely mobile.
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] The Wasp’s mobility and handling were enhanced to emphasize its role as a highly agile unit, ideal for hit-and-run tactics and fast repositioning in battle.

[h2]Level Additions[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Rhino:[/b] Added to the start of [b]Level 2[/b].
    [*][b]Infestor:[/b] Added to the start of [b]Level 3[/b].
    [*][b]Wasp:[/b] Added to the start of [b]Level 5[/b].
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] These units were added early in the campaign to showcase their unique strengths and strategies, allowing players to experiment with them before deciding to unlock them with DNA. This encourages strategic planning and exploration of playstyles.

[h2]Level Improvements[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Level 5 Cutscenes:[/b] Two cutscenes redesigned with improved camera angles to reduce disorientation.
[/list]
[b]Why:[/b] Player feedback indicated that the original cutscene angles were confusing. The updated angles make these moments more engaging and visually coherent, improving the narrative experience.

[h2]Summary[/h2]
This patch addresses critical performance issues, improves unit balance and gameplay progression, and enhances visual and narrative clarity. [b]The Hive 1.301[/b] is designed to provide a smoother, more strategic, and immersive experience for both new and returning players.

All the best,  
[b]Skydome Entertainment[/b]

notes.title: The Hive - Patch 1.300 released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6925470/d10c2efdcccfc7e624ebee54247896416ef7479f.png[/img]

[h1]The Hive - Patch 1.300[/h1]

[h2]Overview[/h2]
This update brings a range of improvements to visuals, gameplay balance, and early-game pacing based on player feedback. Our goal is to make The Hive more visually engaging, intuitive for newcomers, and better balanced overall.

We’ve introduced quality-of-life changes to improve resource visibility in darker areas, refined unit and boss stats for smoother combat, and fixed a critical monitor resolution bug.

[h2]Under the Hood Updates[/h2]
Alongside the visible changes in this patch, we’ve made important updates behind the scenes to improve the game’s infrastructure and prepare for future development:
[list]
[*] Updated Epic SDK to enhance achievement systems.
[*] Created a standalone demo build of The Hive for smaller platforms, increasing accessibility.
[*] Prepared the project for importing into Unity 6, ensuring long-term compatibility and access to advanced development tools.
[/list]
These updates lay the groundwork for future improvements and ensure The Hive continues to run smoothly.

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
We’re committed to improving The Hive and taking player feedback into account as we look toward the future. Here are our primary focus areas moving forward:
[list]
[*] Enhancing Gameplay Balance: Refining combat and resource progression for a smoother, more engaging experience.
[*] Unit Differentiation: Making units feel more unique, both visually and mechanically, to encourage diverse strategies.
[*] Content Expansion: Introducing more units and mechanics to keep gameplay fresh and exciting.
[*] Technical Updates: Ensuring the game remains stable and compatible with new platforms and tools for future updates.
[/list]
Your feedback is invaluable in shaping these updates, so keep sharing your thoughts with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6925470/c50f24987018d2bd5cb47510d242978faaecd645.png[/img]

[h2]Graphics and Visual Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Scene Lighting Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Brightened scenes for better visibility.
[*] Added slight saturation for more vibrant colors.
[/list]
These changes ensure environments are clearer and more visually appealing.

[h3]Improved Object Visibility[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gold piles now emit a soft glow, making them easier to spot in dark areas.
[/list]
This ensures resources are noticeable without disrupting immersion.

[h3]Reflection Probes Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduced new reflection probes to enhance realistic lighting on units and environments.
[/list]
This improves the visual fidelity of objects and characters in the game.

[h3]Dimetrodon Miniboss Color Adjustment[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted Dimetrodon miniboss color for better differentiation and clarity.
[/list]
This change ensures the miniboss stands out effectively in its environment.

[h2]Gameplay Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]Legionnaire Speed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased movement speed from 1.0 to 1.2.
[/list]
This adjustment makes Legionnaires more effective in combat by improving engagement pacing.

[h3]First Level End Boss (Ancient Crab)[/h3]
[list]
[*] HP reduced from 3500 to 3000.
[*] Melee damage reduced from 20 to 15.
[*] Cave-In Ability: Cooldown increased from 10 seconds to 15 seconds, and splash damage reduced from 20 to 10 HP.
[/list]
These tweaks make the Ancient Crab less punishing while retaining its challenge.

[h2]Early Game Enhancements[/h2]

[h3]Starting Units[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players now start the first mission with 1 Behemoth and 2 Medics.
[/list]
This change introduces unit variety early on, encouraging strategic gameplay and showcasing advanced units that can be unlocked later.

[h3]Starting Resources[/h3]
[list]
[*] Food increased from 20 to 100.
[*] Minerals increased from 250 to 350.
[*] Starting population count on first mission increased from 1 to 13.
[*] Population cap raised accordingly.
[/list]
These adjustments provide a smoother economy at the start and encourage unit production experimentation.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Monitor Resolution Bug Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved the error: "Couldn't switch to requested monitor resolution."
[/list]
This fix ensures smoother transitions between monitor settings and eliminates related crashes.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Let us know your thoughts in the comments or forums—we’re excited to keep evolving The Hive and look forward to hearing your ideas for future updates.

All the best,
Skydome Entertainment

notes.title: The Hive 1.100 - Winds of Change
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3gOKrqQHPoXXUOg53G/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1] The Hive 1.100 - Winds of Change [/h1]

Hello everyone! Today we are proud to release update 1.100 Winds of Change for The Hive.

We wanted to especially focus on adding features requested by the community.

Our plan was to update The Hive from Unity Engine 5.6.7 to 2019.1 version.

1.100 update remarks the biggest patch we have done for the game so far.

One of the most significant improvements was to rework the whole game interface and the addition of full 4k support.

Other major visual upgrade was converting the whole project to use linear color space, and the addition of new visual post processing effects.

Also, notable updates are the addition of two new Insectoid buildings, two new units for Chalatoi faction and all new visuals for Infected faction.

We also made all new spell and particle effects utilizing the now available tools.

You can now hide the game interface using (L) key, to take shiny screenshots.

[h1][B]We would love to hear your feedback on the new changes![/B][/h1]

[h1] Gameplay Updates [/h1]
[list]
	[*]New Insectoid buildings, the spring and the burrow (burrow has 4 model variations)
	[*]New enemy units, chalatoi bowman and spearman
	[*]The vast majority of all particle effects in the game have been redone
	[*]Buildings can now be properly selected when they are being built

notes.title: The Hive General Information and FAQ
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/4DBQzZv.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,

I wanted to make this thread to answer some of the basic questions that the community has had. If you want some additional information, feel free to ask :)

[h1]Basic information[/h1]

Story of The Hive is inspired by novel "The Descent" released in 1999. In the novel humans discover caverns of hell beneath pacific ocean and send expedition to explore them.

Gameplay is inspired by Homeworld and Dawn of War series. Level names like "Gehenna" or "Great Wastelands" are homage to Homeworld. There is also Kadesh eye symbol painted on the Chala'toi helmets.

Homeworld is my personal favorite game of all time.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Descent_(novel)

[h1]Design[/h1]

Design of the Insectoid race is based on Crustacean and Arachnid creatures. We did not want to make the insectoids disgusting for players and went after "cool" factor instead.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crustacean

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arachnid

In the original script, first of the Insectoid race is born as you start the game. The waters in planet Eden have special property, that speed up evolution of new primordial creatures significantly. 

Insectoids were going to be amphibian race, that adapted to the dangers of the new world.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Wf6qQFY.jpg[/img]

[h1]Q&A[/h1]

[b]Q: Intro is confusing, what do the humans have to do with the game?[/b]
A: Intro is prelude to explain how the humans arrive on planet Eden. Player is going to encounter them later in the story. 

When the game starts, first of the Insectoids is spawned in the underground world of Eden. The human faction is currently on the planet orbit and surface.

[b]Q: Derelict ship is millions of years old, are they the humans?[/b]
A: Derelict ship had crashed on Eden millions of years before the events of the game. They are not human faction but something entirely different.

It's not the only ship.. there are many more burried on the surface..
Human campaign is going to shed more light, on what caused them to crash on the planet.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9n3aUut.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: How is the story going to continue after Insectoid campaign?[/b]
A: Story would continue with human campaign. Starting from the events happening after arrival on Eden. Human campaign gameplay would be turn based instead of real-time. We had great ideas, that we could not do with the current real-time mechanics.

[b]Q: What is going to be in the next update?[/b]
A: We are currently working on "save where you want" feature and making the gameplay feel smoother.

[b]Q: How big is the development team?[/b]
A: We are small Finnish game studio with core 3 people.

[b]Q: What other games have you worked on before?[/b]
A: My first personal game "Joutomaa" was released on Moddb back in 2010.
It's currently scheduled for Steam release.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=372020592
---
http://steamcommunity.com/app/325730/discussions/0/305510202675378444/

All the best
~Sauli

[h1] The Hive  0.15 Released & Upcoming features [/h1]

Hello everyone, today we are releasing update 0.15 for The Hive

Our plan for this update was to increase performance and continue to integrate The Hive to new Unity 5 engine.

We also worked hard to fix bugs caused by change of engine, for example how new physics work.

We also wanted to talk about upcoming features we have planned for The Hive and community feedback.

[h1] Difficulty modes [/h1]

Our plan has been to introduce Difficulty modes for those that have already completed The Hive and seek more challenge.

Survival Difficulty that let's you keep all the units you have from one level to next and in the same time making the game world more dangerous.

Each difficulty would have it's own save file that you choose from mainmenu

[list]
    [*]Normal difficulty (the current one)
    [*]Survival (Units, resources, dna, items and everything carry over to next mission, monsters are much harder and you resources are more scarce)
    [*]Hard difficulty (Unlocked after completing campaign on normal, increases monster difficulty)
    [*]Insanity difficulty (Unlocked after completing campaign on Hard, more monsters, more difficult, more boss abilities, damage greatly increased)
[/list]

    [*]Simple, clean, easy to read the picture and what it represents

This enables us to make missions where you get more pressure from the opponent, welcome variation to the earlier story heavy missions.     [*]New mission - The Ancient Waterway

    [*]New enemy soldier - Chala'toi axeman
    [*]New enemy soldier - Chala'toi swordsman
    [*]New enemy soldier - Chala'toi worker
    [*]New enemy soldier - Chala'toi spearman
    [*]Chala'toi buildings now have portrait and can be destroyed
    [*]Chala'toi buildings set on fire when damaged
    [*]Insectoid buildings can now be destroyed
    [*]Artifact now has portrait
    [*]Workers now make sound when you issue commands
    [*]Units no longer get stuck on slopes
    [*]A.I now changes target to closest enemy if kited
    [*]A.I improved
    [*]Game now properly saves after each completed level
    [*]You can no longer attack own units
    [*]Medic now has longer heal radius and cant spam heal
    [*]Resurrecting units using Hive now costs 5 food, down from 10
    [*]Camera elevation bug fixed
    [*]Lava Golem cutscene bug fixed
    [*]You can now hear Advisor warning lines on every map (food, resource, popcap)
    [*]You now need to defeat more Chala'toi commanders on third level
    [*]Loading screen tips now show more revelant information
    [*]Pressing "F1" now finds and selects idle workers
